data: Synthetic in-memory fixture; external requests blocked during capture; no production mutations.
visuals: Computed DOM layout converted to SVG primitives; original Lucide and Recharts SVG; subset embedded fonts. No bitmap screenshots embedded.
captureAdjustment: For poster capture only, cleared settled transforms on main div elements to let fixed modal escape transformed ancestors. Production source was not modified.
dependencies: Existing Vite/React/Tailwind, Playwright (PROMO_PLAYWRIGHT may override module path), Chrome, Python fontTools + WOFF2 support, local Arial and PingFang fonts.
limitations: Scene state snapshots with SMIL transitions and click indicators; intermediate text entry and scrolling are condensed. DOM conversion approximates text shaping and dashed borders. No system share or remote delivery is performed.
